name: unshittify
description: A collection of plugins that fix Claude Code annoyances.

plugins.name: local
plugins.description: Manage project-local Claude Code settings (.claude/settings.local.json) that /config and the settings UI don't expose per-project.

plugins.name: racket
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for working in Racket: classes, contracts, macros, concurrency, GUI, drawing, testing, packaging, and more.

plugins.name: global
plugins.description: Inspect and manage the user's global Claude Code settings (~/.claude/settings.json).

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Tooling for authoring Claude Code plugins — writing skills and agents.

plugins.name: communication
plugins.description: Write and review prose in Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100) and format markdown tables: the simplified-technical-english skill holds the condensed STE rules, the review-prose skill and the prose-reviewer agent check prose against STE and this project's house style (the checklist and its curated examples, supplemented by BadProseExamples.org at the repository root when that file is present), and the markdown-tables skill aligns table columns.

plugins.name: development
plugins.description: General software-development tooling not specific to any one language.

plugins.name: cxx
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for C++ development: compiling and running with sanitizers, querying code structure with clang-query, applying this project's C++ editing idioms, and more.
